triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:package · domain:server · Bug · p1 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: an app's `isDefault` permission set installed into a running environment is not bound as the baseline until a restart, so every user with no explicit grant is locked out until then (measured in a smoke run). That is a lockout of every ordinary user on install, so p2 → p1. Graded, not chased (area:package has no seat taking new cards); surfaced to the maintainer. Recorded 2026-11-28T03:14Z.

The boot-time fallbackPermissionSet (serve.ts appSecurityPluginOptions(config)) reads only the deployment's own boot config and never an installed package: rehydrate runs at kernel:ready, after SecurityPlugin is constructed.
